title: ToolApiV1dot5
description: K-09 Tool API v1.5, a minor version for journey 7, before the visit, with the fee door (T-054; 02-contracts K-09 version table, row v1.5; section 9 F17; QUESTIONS w2-m678 question 1's default: S11-22 to S11-28 and S11-35 freeze here as one door, and v1.9 keeps journey 11's other calls). It only adds to v1.4 (tool-api.v1.4.schema.json, frozen by T-053 and unchanged, referred to here, which refers to v1.3, v1.2, v1.1 and v1): every v1 to v1.4 definition is here under its own name by reference; the one changed definition, callName, takes only new enum values. Journey 7 writes no key (A-J7.md, B-J7.md, A-keys.md and B-keys.md: every gives column empty; 02-contracts K-09 v1.5 'Keys written: none'), so stepKey, given, partResult and gateAndCommit stay v1.4's, and every v1 to v1.4 exchange is a v1.5 exchange. Added: the calls of journey 7 (A7-01 to A7-98, B7-01 to B7-88) and the fee door (S11-22 to S11-28, S11-35): remindBeforeVisit, moveBooking, cancelBooking, feeDoor, proCantCome, proRunsLate, ownerChangesIt, classTooFew, changeWhatsBooked, customerRunsLate, changePlan, finalCount, firstStepsDue, relayQuestion, moveUpdates, passOnNote and someoneElseAsks; each answers gives empty, and each request description names its step ids (README 'v1.5', 'Every in-scope step'). Every customer commit carries the customer's own yes with the words shown, written as its K-29 consent in the same commit (README default 129); no fee is charged on silence or without its bound yes (defaults 134, 135); no answer shows another person's data, a stopped number's state or another mobile's holds to a caller whose identity is not proven, and a reply to someone else uses the same words every time (default 148). K-30 v1, K-31 v1 and K-32 v1 are frozen on main: the calls name their tables, columns and closed lists, never redefine them. Not model-facing, so number and length limits are schema rules here. Owner: the architect.

callName.description: Every call v1.5 holds: v1.4's, journey 7's (remindBeforeVisit, moveBooking, cancelBooking, proCantCome, proRunsLate, ownerChangesIt, classTooFew, changeWhatsBooked, customerRunsLate, changePlan, finalCount, firstStepsDue, relayQuestion, moveUpdates, passOnNote, someoneElseAsks) and the fee door's (feeDoor). Each has <call>.request, <call>.response and <call>.errors under $defs (02-contracts section 2 item 2), and each but plannerVerbs a <call>.exchange.

journeySevenCustomerSide.title: JourneySevenCustomerSide
journeySevenCustomerSide.description: A customer stage of journey 7 acts for the booking's own person, from their own chat (a turn whose texts are theirs: every yes there is an open question's answer, never words a page sends) or their own secure page (the page server's signed link names the person, never the browser: K-21; K-22 v1 rule 4); never an outside AI, a job or the console (README defaults 129 and 152; A7-98: 'asked in Alex's own chat'; S13-55: 'Never a yes relayed in a chat by someone else's AI'). Who that is (the person served, or someone allowed to decide for them: S13-31) is checked on the server against the booking, and anyone else answers notAllowed with the same words for every number (README default 148).

journeySevenOwnerSide.title: JourneySevenOwnerSide
journeySevenOwnerSide.description: An owner stage acts for the owner or an admin the owner lets answer (K-22 v1 who OKs what), in their own turn or on Needs you (K-21), in K-08's ownerYes shape; never an AI, a job, the console or the customer (S11-25: 'Only Sam's yes takes it'; A7-23: 'Sam's command is read back first'). notAllowed for anyone else.

journeySevenStaffSide.title: JourneySevenStaffSide
journeySevenStaffSide.description: A staff stage acts for a staff member of the business in their own chat (A7-14: 'Riley texts LATE'; A7-15: 'Riley texts in sick'; A7-12: the pro's quick answer), the person set on the server from the turn's sender.

journeySevenJobSide.title: JourneySevenJobSide
journeySevenJobSide.description: A job stage is made by a job of the action layer (the reminder sweep, a due notice, C-101's job on a charge's result, K-31's no-show clock), acting for no person; a job's commit writes no outbox row, so its messages go by clock rows due at once (v1.4 default 112).

journeySevenMessage.title: JourneySevenMessage
journeySevenMessage.description: One message a journey 7 commit writes, as v1.4's messageWritten (README v1.4 default 112), with one more reader: other, someone who is not the booking's person, the owner or staff (A7-80's asker, A7-81's teller), answered in their own chat in the same turn and named by no person when the record holds none for them. It names the step whose line it carries (K-01 step lines; README default 130 where the step prints no line for that reader), the way it goes (the reader's open chat, else their email: MC C9, Rosie never writes first), its send class (K-07 v1: only routine waits for text hours) and the open question it asks, if any. In a turn it is an outbox row of that commit; from a page's or a job's commit a clock row due at once on the reader's handle, whose clock turn writes the row and its question.

to.description: customer (the person the booking's messages go to: S13-31), owner (the owner or an admin the owner lets answer), staff (the pro on the job, or a stand-in asked in), other (A7-80, A7-81: a third party).

personId.description: The reader (persons.id); null only for other with no person row.

journeySevenTime.title: JourneySevenTimeOffered
journeySevenTime.description: One time offered as an option of the question the commit writes (A7-03's 'A) Sat Oct 24 · 3:00pm · Riley'): its option id, which a pick carries (the option id, never a label or a time the caller sends: v1.4 default 114's way), its label as sent, the time in UTC (shown in the visit's zone: S13-03) and the K-04 resource. Only the booked person's open times that keep the plug-in's gap, at the line's copied price (README default 132; v1.4 default 122).

journeySevenChange.title: JourneySevenChange
journeySevenChange.description: One K-30 booking_changes row the commit wrote (appended, never edited: FS line 756; S13-56): its booking and visit, its kind (moved, cancelled, stand_in, what_changed), who asked (customer, owner, staff, team, rosie), whether it came after free cancel ended (by the clock the customer was shown: B7-10), and the exact yes behind it in K-08's approval shape: the K-29 consent this commit wrote from the customer's own yes (consentRow, README default 129), the owner's yes (ownerYes), or a deadline's safe default (safeDefault: K-30 approved_by null; only a call-off moves on silence, S13-56). A change the customer asked for is always bound to their consent.

journeySevenRefund.title: JourneySevenRefund
journeySevenRefund.description: One K-32 refunds row the commit wrote: what the booking's terms or the business give back, never a refund on Rosie's own (RULES 3.10; A7-74: 'Never: refund or keep money on Rosie's own, beyond what the terms give'): cancel_in_time (everything back, as the booking took it: A7-05), called_off (the business cancelled or could not give it: A7-20, A7-66, A7-69), fee_rest (the rest above the one fee kept, or everything when no fee is taken: S11-24, S11-26, S11-27, S11-35) or price_lowered (a cheaper service before free cancel ends: A7-31). Through Stripe it runs from one K-07 stripe_refund effect; money paid outside Rosie is the business's own way (no effect).

journeySevenFee.title: JourneySevenFeeAsked
journeySevenFee.description: The K-32 booking_fees row S11-25 asks about (FS line 733; S11-22 to S11-28): its kind (late_cancel, no_show, nobody_home, ended_early), the amount the customer agreed to (the booking's one fee: K-30 booking_lines.fee_cents, never more than what was paid now: S13-55), what it comes from (payment, card or credit: S11-23), the owner's deadline 24 hours after asking (S11-25: 'No answer by 1:45pm Wed: no fee') and the clock row of the one reminder in the owner's text hours (S11-28).

feeChargeBound.title: FeeChargeBound
feeChargeBound.description: S11-26's charge of the one fee: a K-32 payment of purpose fee, pending, naming its booking_fees row, with its one K-07 effect (a stripe_charge on the saved card, or, after that charge is declined, the one stripe_pay_link: 'Declined: one pay link goes to the customer'), never with the customer present (S11-25: the owner's yes after the visit), and the bound yes behind it (README default 135; v1.4 default 127's form; K-32 v1 rule 10, unbound_charge): its effect.created event-log row's approved_by names, as K-08 consentRow, the K-29 consent of the words the customer agreed to the fee with, the booking's terms snapshot's (K-30 booking_terms.terms_consent_id: 'Ben agreed to the shop's no-show fee when booking'). Only K-14's result, or paymentSucceeded, makes it paid; nothing is held (RULES 3.2); a decline is never retried (S11-26).

journeySevenAnswer.title: JourneySevenAnswer
journeySevenAnswer.description: What a journey 7 or fee-door stage wrote, in one shape for every call but someoneElseAsks: the booking (null where the stage is about a worker's day or a class session, not one booking), the stage and the step whose write it is, the result, the messages and questions written (each with its reader, way and send class), the times offered, the deadline the commit armed (its question clock or a clock row: never a call, README default 151), the K-30 change rows, the K-29 consent written from the customer's own yes (README default 129), the K-30 owner_oks row, the fee asked (S11-25), the fee charged with its bound yes (S11-26), a pay link's id (never its url: it reaches only the payer's own ways), the refunds, the effects to run after the commit (stripe_charge, stripe_refund, stripe_pay_link, calendar_update, calendar_delete), the money words with the row each reads (v1.4 journeySixMoneyWord; S13-55: a money word only as the record says), the walk's next call, the keys given (none: journey 7 gives no key, README default 128), the rows written and whether this was a repeat. A check-in code is never in an answer: it reaches its person only through the slot filler (K-03 visit.code; v1.4 default 119).

consentId.description: The K-29 consent this commit wrote from the customer's own yes, with its exact words shown and their sha256 (README default 129); null when no customer yes committed anything. A consent row carries no version, so written never lists it (K-29 v1 rule 2).

next.description: The call the walk goes on to: offerTimes (moveBooking offer, in the same commit or the page's next call), feeDoor (feeDoor open, walked in the same commit: S11-22), ownerReaches (the owner reaches the customer their way by S13-56's deadline: A7-15's '2', A7-21), or none.

allOf.description: A change the customer asked for is bound to the consent this commit wrote from their own yes (README default 129): the answer names that consent (the named rule journeySevenGivesNone checks that the change names the same one).

bookingEndedError.title: BookingEndedError
bookingEndedError.description: The booking is no longer before its visit, so nothing was written: cancelled (K-04 bookings.stage), or a visit already under way or done (A7-92: 'A visit already under way ... is never the before-visit cancel. It goes by A8-41's line').

notOwnChatError.title: NotOwnChatError
notOwnChatError.description: A7-98, B7-88: where updates go is changed only in the customer's own chat (or by the email code on file: D100); asked from any other number, email or chat, nothing changes, and the reply says how, in the same words whether or not a booking exists (A3-43; README default 146). The error names nothing about any booking.

welfareFirstError.title: WelfareFirstError
welfareFirstError.description: S11-22: 'It runs only once a welfare check, where one applies, found them safe (S13-10)'. The fee door was opened before that, so nothing was written.

waitsForPersonError.title: WaitsForPersonError
waitsForPersonError.description: S11-22: 'After a stop or an ask to cancel, it waits until a person has reached them their way (judgment rule 24)'. A bare STOP or CANCEL came and no person has marked them reached, so nothing was written.

feeAnsweredError.title: FeeAnsweredError
feeAnsweredError.description: The fee is no longer asked (K-32 booking_fees.state owner_yes, charged or dropped; set once), so nothing was written: a second answer, or an answer after the 24 hours ran out (S11-28: 'With no answer 24 hours after he was asked, there's no fee').

remindBeforeVisit.request.title: RemindBeforeVisitRequest
remindBeforeVisit.request.description: A7-01 (B7-01 after B7-55's 'A set time: reminded first'), 'Reminds Alex before free cancel ends'; gives no key. One stage, remind, made by the reminder job (C-054's sweep over K-30 booking_visits.cutoff_at) for one booked visit: 'One reminder for each booked time, before free cancel ends', at least 3 hours before free cancel ends, inside the customer's text hours (9am to 8pm; with no cutoff, 10am the day before); A7-54's (B7-52's) plan charge due that day or the next rides on it as one line (README defaults 131, 142). Written through a clock row due at once on the customer's handle, routine, into their open chat or else by email (MC C9), with A7-01's line and its options '1 Change the time', '2 Call off the visit' as sent; the code goes only to its person, through the slot filler (K-03 visit.code; flow B's reminder carries none). None for a booking made after this hour, a cancelled or paused booking, one with a death report, a job sent now (B7-55: 'A job sent now gets no reminder'), or while a crisis is open (A7-87: 'No fee, reminder or rating goes out while it's open'): the answer says which. Primary, uncached. Business: caller.businessId. Person: none (a job). Repeat: caller.requestId is the key; one reminder per visit (a repeat answers the first). Version: new rows at version 1.

remindBeforeVisit.response.title: RemindBeforeVisitResponse
remindBeforeVisit.response.description: reminded (A7-01's row, deadline the visit's free-cancel time) or why none goes: madeAfterReminder, cancelled, paused, deceased, sentNow, safetyOpen. No key, no code.

remindBeforeVisit.errors.title: RemindBeforeVisitErrors
remindBeforeVisit.errors.description: Refused, nothing written: notAllowed (not the reminder job), notFound (no such visit of this booking), transient.

remindBeforeVisit.exchange.title: RemindBeforeVisitExchange
remindBeforeVisit.exchange.description: One remindBeforeVisit request with its outcome.

moveBooking.request.title: MoveBookingRequest
moveBooking.request.description: A move to another time of the same booking: A7-03 (B7-07), 'Offers new times; moves it', and every step whose walk offers the customer new times: A7-19 (B7-65) after the pro can't come, A7-13 (B7-17) on the pro's '2 Better to move it', A7-14 (B7-18) on '2 Move my visit', A7-23 (B7-28) on '2 Another time', A7-70 (B7-27) on '2 A later time', A7-74 (B7-61) when something needed first is not done, A7-21 (B7-22) when they still reply, A7-69 (B7-63) on '1 Pick another class'; gives no key. Three stages (README default 132). offer: the booked person's open times that keep the plug-in's gap, at the line's copied price ('Only Riley's times are offered'), as the options of one question, with its clock (24 hours for the customer's own move; the step's own deadline where the business changed the plan) and, where the business changed the plan, its free cancel kept ('Reply C Call off, no fee'); cause says whose change it is. pick: the customer's pick by option id with their own yes: before free cancel ends (or where the business changed the plan) the visit moves at once in one commit: the new time reserved and the old one released (K-05 v1 reserve, release), K-30 booking_visits.reservation_id and, for a free move, cutoff_at moved with the visit ('The code stays the same: it's still the same visit'; K-30 rule 6 never updates the code), a booking_changes row moved bound to the consent this commit writes from the yes (README default 129), a calendar_update effect, the customer's confirmation and the pro's notice ('Change: ...'); after free cancel ends it is a request to the owner (K-30 owner_oks about late_move: 'accept, another time, or decline. Silence keeps the booking as it is'), the time saved as K-05 v1 allows, and 'No free cancel' shown before the yes. ownerAnswer: the owner's answer to a late move: accept moves it, keeping the old free-cancel time; anotherTime offers the business's own times; decline keeps the booking as it is and tells the customer. Silence moves nothing: the question clocks fire (never this call). Primary, uncached. Business: caller.businessId. Person: the customer for pick; the owner or a permitted admin for ownerAnswer; the turn's sender, the page's person or none (a job) for offer; set on the server. Repeat: caller.requestId is the key; a repeat answers the first. Version: booking_visits, reservations and owner_oks compared and set (limit 4); new rows at version 1.

cause.description: customer (their own move: free before free cancel ends, a request to the owner after) or business (the business changed the plan: every choice free, the free cancel kept: A7-19, S13-56).

optionId.description: The chosen time's option id as the question stores it (K-04 open_questions.options); code reads the time from the stored option, never from the caller.

answer.description: accept, anotherTime or decline (A7-03: 'accept, another time, or decline'). No value for silence.

allOf.description: An offer comes from a turn, the customer's own page or a job (A7-74's check); never an outside AI or the console.

journeySevenMoveStep.title: JourneySevenMoveStep
journeySevenMoveStep.description: The steps whose walk offers the customer new times of the same booking (moveBooking).

moveBooking.response.title: MoveBookingResponse
moveBooking.response.description: offer: offered (the times and their question) or noTimeKeepsGap ('No time keeps the gap: a new pair of times, another service, or a free cancel'); pick: moved (the change bound to the consent, the calendar update, the confirmation and the pro's notice) or askedOwner (the late move's owner_oks); ownerAnswer: moved, offered or declined. No key.

moveBooking.errors.title: MoveBookingErrors
moveBooking.errors.description: Refused, nothing written: bookingEnded, priceDiffers (a time whose price is not the line's copy: v1.4 default 122), timeTaken (the picked time went in the meantime: offer again), requestEnded (an answer to a late move that already ended), wordsDiffer (a page's words that are not the stored ones), notAllowed (not the customer; not the owner or a permitted admin), notFound, versionChanged, constraint, bookingPaused, transient.

moveBooking.exchange.title: MoveBookingExchange
moveBooking.exchange.description: One moveBooking request with its outcome (the named rule journeySevenGivesNone checks that a response answers the stage it was sent).

cancelBooking.request.title: CancelBookingRequest
cancelBooking.request.description: The customer's cancel before the visit: A7-05 (B7-08, B7-09), 'Asks once more, then cancels', and A7-06 (B7-10), 'Warns about the fee first'; gives no key. Two stages, both the customer's own (README default 133). ask: in time ('before free cancel ends, or any time when the booking can't keep a fee'; a fee-free customer or reason too) the question 'Cancel your Sat 11:00am visit with Riley? It's free. / Reply 1 Keep it, 2 Call it off', its clock one more ask before free cancel ends; late (after free cancel ends, judged by the clock the customer was shown) the warning 'It's past the free-cancel time (Fri 11am). So Lee's Barbershop {{pay.late}}. Cancel anyway? / Reply 1 Keep it, 2 Call it off anyway', its money word read from the line's fee. confirm: the second yes ('Never: cancel on a single tap or a slip, without the second yes'), carrying the customer's own yes, which the commit writes as a K-29 ticked_terms consent with the words shown and their sha256 (README default 129): in one commit the head cancelled (K-04 bookings.stage), the hold released (K-05 v1 release, cancelled), a booking_changes row cancelled bound to that consent, a calendar_delete effect, the customer's reply and the pro's notice; in time anything paid comes back as the booking took it (refunds cancel_in_time) and a card saved only for this booking is removed; late, nothing is charged here ('Never: charge on this text. The owner decides any fee (S11-22)'): the walk goes on in the same commit through the fee door (feeDoor open, S11-22: README default 134), whose question to the owner, or whose one line telling him why no fee may be asked, this answer carries, and 'Lee's Barbershop decides about the fee by Sat 2:05pm' is the customer's reply. '1 Keep it' and no reply commit nothing: the question clock's (never this call). Several bookings open: 'Rosie asks which one first' (v1.1 checkBookingFirst). Primary, uncached. Business: caller.businessId. Person: the customer, set on the server. Repeat: caller.requestId is the key; a repeat answers the first. Version: the head and booking_visits compared and set (limit 4); new rows at version 1.

yes.description: The customer's own second yes ('2 Call it off', '2 Call it off anyway'): in their chat the open question and the reply's event, whose stored words are the words shown; on their own secure page the tap with the words the page server showed.

cancelBooking.response.title: CancelBookingResponse
cancelBooking.response.description: ask: askedOnce (in time) or warnedFee (late); confirm: cancelled (in time, with its refunds) or cancelledLate (the fee door walked: its question to the owner in fee, or the owner's one line in messages). Every confirm names the consent written from the customer's own yes and the change bound to it. No key.

cancelBooking.errors.title: CancelBookingErrors
cancelBooking.errors.description: Refused, nothing written: bookingEnded (already cancelled, or under way: A7-92), wordsDiffer, notAllowed (not the booking's own person), notFound, versionChanged, constraint, transient.

cancelBooking.exchange.title: CancelBookingExchange
cancelBooking.exchange.description: One cancelBooking request with its outcome.

feeDoor.request.title: FeeDoorRequest
feeDoor.request.description: The fee door, S11-22 to S11-28 and S11-35 (C-106; QUESTIONS w2-m678 question 1's default: frozen here as one door, for journey 7's late cancels and journey 8's no-shows, nobody home and visits ended early); gives no key. Three stages (README defaults 134, 135). open (S11-22, 'A fee question goes to Sam': from the walk of A7-06 or B7-10 in the customer's turn, from A8-56 or B8-60 in a turn, or from K-31's no-show clock after A8-16 or B8-12, a job): 'May a fee be asked at all?' Never (a fee-free customer or reason, a time set on silence, sensitive work unless the owner set its own fee, a visit the business couldn't give or the owner couldn't answer for) is S11-35: the owner told why in one line, nothing charged, anything paid back by what was taken; else S11-23, 'What can a fee come from?': nothing taken is S11-24 (the owner told, the customer told no fee, anything paid back); a card, a payment or a credit is S11-25: one K-32 booking_fees row asked (its kind, the amount the customer agreed to, what it comes from, the owner's question naming the reason, the amount, what it comes from, the deadline and what silence does, with its options '1 Charge or keep it', '2 No fee', its deadline 24 hours later, and one reminder's clock row in his text hours). It runs only once a welfare check, where one applies, found them safe, and after a stop or an ask to cancel only once a person reached them (welfareFirst, waitsForPerson). ownerAnswer (S11-25, the owner or a permitted admin, their turn or Needs you, in K-08's ownerYes shape): charge is S11-26: out of a payment the fee is kept and the rest refunded (fee_rest); on the saved card a K-32 payment of purpose fee, pending, with its stripe_charge, bound to the customer's own yes to the fee (feeChargeBound: README default 135); a credit is used and not given back; noFee is S11-27: dropped, anything paid back. chargeResult (C-101's job on the card charge's result): paid is charged, S11-26's receipt to the customer ('Think this is wrong? Reply here'); declined is one pay link to the payer's own ways only (their open chat, their email: never an AI, the owner or a pro), the owner told, never retried. Silence never charges: S11-28's reminder and its 24 hours are the question's clock rows, which drop the fee and tell the customer (gateAndCommit, input.kind clock), never this call. Primary, uncached. Business: caller.businessId. Person: the owner or a permitted admin for ownerAnswer; none for a job; the turn's sender for open in a turn. Repeat: caller.requestId is the key; a repeat answers the first. Version: booking_fees and payments compared and set; new rows at version 1.

reason.description: K-32 booking_fees.kind: late_cancel (A7-06, B7-10), no_show (A8-16), nobody_home (B8-12), ended_early (A8-56, B8-60).

from.description: The step that sends it (S11-22: 'The step that sends it gives the reason, the visit, the time the customer was shown, and anything set on silence').

shownCutoffAt.description: The free-cancel time the customer was shown (B7-10: 'Late is judged by the clock the customer was shown'); null for a no-show.

setOnSilence.description: Whether the time was set or moved on silence (S11-22: a time set on silence is a 'Never' reason).

cancelYesConsentId.description: For a late cancel, the K-29 consent the cancel's commit wrote from the customer's own 'Call it off anyway' with the words shown (README default 129); null otherwise.

welfareFoundSafeAt.description: When a welfare check found them safe, where one applies (S11-22; S13-10); null where none applies.

personReachedAt.description: After a stop or a bare CANCEL, when a person marked them reached their way (judgment rule 24); null otherwise.

answer.description: charge ('1 Charge or keep it'; on a credit visit, 'Use the credit') or noFee ('2 No fee'). There is no value for silence: S11-28 is the question's clock.

expectVersion.description: The booking_fees row's version the question was asked on (limit 4).

result.description: The charge's result as the runtime side applied it (K-32 rule 5): paid, or declined (never retried).

allOf.description: The door opens from a turn's walk or a job; never a page, an AI or the console.

feeDoor.response.title: FeeDoorResponse
feeDoor.response.description: open: noFeeMayBeAsked (S11-35), nothingTaken (S11-24) or askedOwner (S11-25, with the fee asked); ownerAnswer: charged (S11-26: kept out of a payment, or a credit used), charging (S11-26: the saved card charged, pending, with its bound yes) or dropped (S11-27); chargeResult: charged (S11-26's receipt) or payLinkSent (one pay link to the payer, the owner told). No key.

allOf.description: Every fee payment this commit writes, the charge or its one pay link, names its bound yes (README default 135).

feeDoor.errors.title: FeeDoorErrors
feeDoor.errors.description: Refused, nothing written: welfareFirst, waitsForPerson (S11-22), feeAnswered (a second answer, or after the deadline), notPaidYet (chargeResult paid for a payment that is not paid), notAllowed (an AI, the customer or anyone the owner does not let answer; not C-101's job), notFound, versionChanged, constraint (a second fee for one visit: K-32 one fee per booking, S13-55), transient.

feeDoor.exchange.title: FeeDoorExchange
feeDoor.exchange.description: One feeDoor request with its outcome.

proCantCome.request.title: ProCantComeRequest
proCantCome.request.description: The pro can't come (A7-93, B7-90; S13-56's one path): A7-15 (B7-19), 'Asks Sam: ask a stand-in in, or call?', A7-17 (B7-20), 'Offers a stand-in, new times or a free cancel', A7-18, 'Moves it to the stand-in; confirms', A7-20 (B7-21), 'Cancels with no fee'; A7-19 and B7-65's new times are moveBooking offer, and A7-21 (B7-22)'s no reply is the question's clock; gives no key. Four stages (README default 136). report (the pro in their own chat, or the owner): the pro's day blocked for this visit; where someone with the skill and any license the business needs could stand in, and the booking named nobody, the owner is asked (A7-15's line, '1 Ask Avery in early', '2 I'll call them', its clock 30 minutes); else the owner is told, with no question, and the customer offered new times with the same pro or a free cancel. ownerAnswer: askStandIn asks the stand-in in first ('Avery only once Avery says yes'); ownerReaches ends the path: the owner reaches the customer by S13-56's deadline. standInAnswer (the stand-in's own chat): yes offers the customer A7-17's three choices; no offers new times or a free cancel. customerAnswer (the customer's own yes, written as its consent: README default 129): standIn moves the visit to the stand-in, same time, price and code (a booking_changes row stand_in, the stand-in told); anotherTime walks to moveBooking offer, no fee; callOff cancels it with no fee and everything paid for it back (refunds called_off), the owner told.
